# Olive Oil Lovers

> > Premium extra virgin olive oil retailer featuring award-winning oils from Italy, Spain, Greece, and beyond.

Olive Oil Lovers curates exceptional extra virgin olive oils from renowned producers like Frantoi Cutrera, Mandranova, and Oro del Desierto, specializing in single-estate, monocultivar, and organic selections. The collection emphasizes award-winners from NYIOOC, IOC, Olive Japan, and LA International EVOOC competitions, with options ranging from mild Arbequina to robust Coratina and Picual varieties.

## Key Topics

- Extra Virgin Olive Oil
- Award-winning oils (NYIOOC, IOC, Olive Japan, LA International EVOOC)
- Italian olive oil (Sicily, Tuscany, Puglia)
- Spanish olive oil (Andalusia)
- Monocultivar varieties (Arbequina, Coratina, Frantoio, Leccino, Hojiblanca, Picual)
- Organic olive oil
- Intensity profiles (mild, medium-robust, robust)
- Premium producers (Frantoi Cutrera, Mandranova, Oro del Desierto)
- Sicilian olive oil
- Andalusian olive oil
- Greek olive oil (Koroneiki)
- Bulk sizes (3L, 5L)
- Gift sets and samplers
